name: Killing Eve
description: A security consultant hunts for a ruthless assassin. Equally obsessed with each other, they go head to head in an epic game of cat-and-mouse.

videos.title: Nice Face
videos.overview: MI5 security officer Eve Polastri is bored in her job and yearns for a more exciting life. When a Russian politician is murdered, Eve is tasked with protecting the only witness and soon finds herself on a collision course with a violent and extraordinary assassin, Villanelle.

videos.title: I'll Deal With Him Later
videos.overview: In the aftermath of her recent assignment, Villanelle is ordered to take a break. Never one to do as she's told, she goes ahead with her next mission regardless. Meanwhile, Eve is given a dream opportunity to join a secret MI6 unit tracking Villanelle and the shady organization she works for.

videos.title: Don't I Know You?
videos.overview: When Villanelle kills a Chinese colonel at a kink clinic in Berlin, Eve and Bill travel out to investigate. While Eve and Bill chase up a number of promising leads, Villanelle enjoys the cat-and-mouse of their proximity. But as they draw closer, Eve comes to realize that this is much more than a game.

videos.title: Sorry Baby
videos.overview: Intel from Berlin points to the existence of a mole, prompting Eve to undertake her first surveillance operation. Meanwhile, Villanelle is sent to England to eliminate a member of British Intelligence. Villanelle wonders, could it be Eve?

videos.title: I Have a Thing About Bathrooms
videos.overview: Having survived a terrifying close call with Villanelle, Eve now has the mole ensconced in a safe house and is buzzing. They have an exciting opportunity to glean information and crack this thing open.

videos.title: Take Me to the Hole!
videos.overview: A female assassin is taken into custody in Russia, and Eve and Carolyn head out to Moscow to negotiate access. She could hold the key to the organization that runs Villanelle. Meanwhile, Villanelle is smuggled into the same Russian jail. It's a grim and brutal place, where not even Villanelle is safe.

videos.title: I Don't Want To Be Free
videos.overview: Tensions are running high as the situation in Moscow escalates, and Eve starts to question who she can trust. Despite the danger, with her sights firmly set on Villanelle, Eve goes rogue. With both women under pressure, the stakes are higher than ever.

videos.title: God, I'm Tired
videos.overview: Villanelle's mission is proving anything but straightforward, forcing her to take drastic measures. Meanwhile, Eve makes a shocking discovery, which leads her right to Villanelle and an electrifying confrontation from which neither will emerge unscathed.

videos.title: Do You Know How to Dispose of a Body?
videos.overview: Eve is reeling from her act of violence against Villanelle and doesn't know whether she is alive or dead. A paranoid and severely injured Villanelle manages to get herself to the hospital for treatment. Carolyn approaches Eve with an intriguing opportunity.

videos.title: Nice and Neat
videos.overview: Carolyn introduces Eve to her new team before Eve briefs them on the Villanelle case. Villanelle, needing to lie low while she recovers, finds a good Samaritan to take her in and care for her.

videos.title: The Hungry Caterpillar
videos.overview: Villanelle's new circumstances are looking bleak, while Eve makes a dangerous deal with an old acquaintance. Villanelle is surprised when she is approached by a figure from her past.

videos.title: Desperate Times
videos.overview: Villanelle decides to take matters into her own hands on a trip to Amsterdam. Carolyn is called in to face the music with her boss. After the discovery of another dead body, Eve and her new team make a break in their case.

videos.title: Smell Ya Later
videos.overview: The MI6 team make a pact with the devil in order to get information from The Ghost. A visitor from Broadmoor comes with a dire warning, while Eve and Villanelle find themselves closer than ever.

videos.title: I Hope You Like Missionary!
videos.overview: The point of no return: Villanelle uses her unrivaled infiltration skills to immerse herself in the world of a new target. Their relationship on the rocks, Eve and Niko confront each other about their future.

videos.title: Wide Awake
videos.overview: Villanelle dives deep into the dangerous world of her target under the guise of her newfound persona, Billie. Eve may have worrying competition for Villanelle's affections.

videos.title: You're Mine
videos.overview: Eve's mission is disastrously compromised. Carolyn briefs Eve on her current status as an employee of the British government and leaves Eve's future in her own hands. Villanelle does everything she can in order to get to her ultimate target.

videos.title: Slowly Slowly Catchy Monkey
videos.overview: Eve attempts to rebuild her life, having been shot and left for dead in Rome by Villanelle. Villanelle, believing Eve to be dead, is approached by an old foe who offers her a new opportunity.

videos.title: Management Sucks
videos.overview: Eve strikes up an unlikely alliance with Kenny’s colleagues at the Bitter Pill, and Villanelle finds that management is not all it is cracked up to be.

videos.title: Meetings Have Biscuits
videos.overview: Villanelle agrees to a job that will take her back to London. Carolyn’s Moscow contacts come in useful when Eve and the team uncover a potential lead.

videos.title: Still Got It
videos.overview: Eve tries to patch things up with Niko, and Villanelle receives good news about her upcoming promotion.

videos.title: Are You from Pinner?
videos.overview: Villanelle returns home to Mother Russia to try to find her family. Perhaps a new connection to her roots will give her back what has been missing in her life.

videos.title: End of Game
videos.overview: Carolyn finds out that information is being withheld by those close to her, and Eve finds a lead which might bring her closer to Villanelle.

videos.title: Beautiful Monster
videos.overview: Eve finds a clue to Villanelle's whereabouts in the most unlikely of places, Villanelle and Dasha work together on a kill, and the pressure is getting to Konstantin.

videos.title: Are You Leading or Am I?
videos.overview: Konstantin makes a break for it, while Eve and Villanelle try to work out what the future may hold for them - together or apart.

videos.title: Just Dunk Me
videos.overview: Eve sets out for her revenge against The Twelve, even if it kills her. Villanelle tries to reform.

videos.title: Don't Get Eaten
videos.overview: Eve confronts Helene and seeks her aid against The Twelve. Villanelle's attempts to reform continue.

videos.title: A Rainbow in Beige Boots
videos.overview: Eve finds the name of Helene's target. Villanelle forces an MI6 psychiatrist to give her therapy.

videos.title: It's Agony and I'm Ravenous
videos.overview: Eve establishes her boundaries with Villanelle. Helene sets a challenge for Eve.

videos.title: Don't Get Attached
videos.overview: Eve seeks out any information about The Twelve's origin, but uncovers more than she bargained for.

videos.title: Oh Goodie, I'm The Winner
videos.overview: Eve nurses Villanelle back to health, then heads to Berlin to try to take her revenge on Lars.

videos.title: Making Dead Things Look Nice
videos.overview: Eve begins to question her identity and her actions, and she rekindles a relationship with Gunn.

videos.title: Hello, Losers
videos.overview: Eve recruits Villanelle for revenge against The Twelve, even at the cost of their own lives.

language: English, French, Spanish, Catalan, Russian, Polish, Romanian
awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 49 wins & 162 nominations total
